# op_group (Data Source)

Retrieves a 1Password group by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Group ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description.
- `group_type` (String) Group type, e.g. `userDefined`.
- `state` (String) `active`, `deleted`, or `unsupported`.
- `title` (String) Group title.
